#journal #hiring

Lieke's contract came back signed this morning, she starts 2 June. Five loops, forty-one CVs, one yes. The rubric held up, see [[Hiring loop rubric]], even if Jens' roleplay is still too scary. Spent the evening on her [[Onboarding checklist]] with a glass of white on the balcony, 19 degrees at 21:00, first real summer evening. Vondelpark 10k is Sunday. Longest run so far 8.3 km. Scared and fine.
